section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical methods used to analyze data from a sample of Black college women. The study employed SPSS 19.0 for descriptive statistics and independent samples t-tests, Mplus for exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and bootstrapping-based mediation analyses. Table 1 presents descriptive statistics (means and standard deviations) for 11 measures including the BAS (M = 3.87, SD = 0.76), various subscales of eating disorder and appearance-related instruments, and other psychological constructs.
